content.value: You are given two tables: Result and Distinction. The Result table contains the grades (16) [CO2] of all students in all subjects. The Distinction table contains the conditions for a student to pass with distinction, i.e., a student must get the same grades specified in the distinction table for all subjects to be a distinction holder.
